tests.initial_failures: pytest entry point lacked repo sys.path; rerun via python -m pytest. One new assertion compared a structured contact locator to an integer; corrected test to compare full locator. No implementation failure in those runs.

limitations: Rigid six-cell translation only; no added vertical collision sides, no seam stitching or arbitrary topology writer.

Visible mapping uses three static meshes and preserves their connectivity. Extra render vertices and neighboring faces make boundary height blending differ from the collision step. Nearby prop mesh128 is not edited.
The rough +100 stored Y correspondence is descriptive, not a proven skin-generation algorithm.
Static consumer is reused from R1. Live pointers, full vertex arrays, and restored-frame effect are verified; no instruction trace of this live draw invocation was taken.
Region was chosen after first raised/paired captures, before restored-control capture; exploratory localization, not a blinded preregistered mask.
Animation differs outside the static ROI. Matched current pose/camera is not whole renderer state equality.
The two jump arcs have different apex heights under wall-clock-held input; both settle on the edited group. They are not a deterministic replay comparison.
All new evidence is unaudited by an independent agent; R2q/CAP-010 acceptance unchanged.
